item.title: The President gave an instruction to establish a separate educational programme for special military operations veterans without university degrees
item.description: The President gave an instruction to establish a separate educational programme for special military operations veterans without university degrees For the Time of Heroes programme, we only pick those soldiers who have a higher education degree and, ideally, some experience in organisational or administrative work. However, many of the soldiers at the front lines do not have a completed higher education. And for this category of soldiers, we also must create the necessary conditions so they could realise their potential in civil service. A separate, special programme should be developed for them.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30454

The President gave an instruction to establish a separate educational programme for special military operations veterans without university degrees
For the Time of Heroes programme, we only pick those soldiers who have a higher education degree and, ideally, some experience in organisational or administrative work. However, many of the soldiers at the front lines do not have a completed higher education. And for this category of soldiers, we also must create the necessary conditions so they could realise their potential in civil service. A separate, special programme should be developed for them.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30451

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation
.
🔥
In Kharkov region,
strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, motorised infantry brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade close to Berezhnoye, Doroshenkovo, Garbuzovka, and Kolodeznoye (Kharkov region).
💥
In addition
, units of a mechanised brigade and a territorial defence brigade have been hit near Markovka and Nikolskoye in Sumy region.
▪️
The enemy lost more than 180 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 17 motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations.
▫️
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line
. Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade near Studenok, Smorodkovka (Kharkov region), Bogorodichnoye, and Krymki (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 220 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles including one U.S.-made M113 armoured personnel carrier, 12 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
↗️
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation
. Strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, as well as a marine brigade close to Slavyansk, Kramatorsk, Yasnogorka, Kondratovka, and Starodubovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 185 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 27 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station.
👉

item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 5 November 2026
item.description: 🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 5 November 2026 Part 2 ( 👉 see Part 1 ) ↗️ The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions. Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an assault brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and three national guard brigades close to Sergeyevka, Varvarovka, Bokovoye, Krivorozhye, Yakovlevka, Belozerskoye, and Kamenka (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 345 troops, nine armoured fighting vehicles, seven motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and three electronic warfare stations. 📍 The Vostok Group's units advanced into the depth of the enemy's defence . Manpower and hardware of an air assault brigade, an assault brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two marine brigades have been hit close to Chernenkovo (Dnepropetrovsk region), Kirovo, Zheltaya Krucha, Vasilevskoye, and Novorozovka (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ The AFU lost up to 215 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and four motor vehicles have been neutralised. ↗️ The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line . Formations of a mechanised brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and a territorial defence brigade were hit close to Orekhov and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ Up to 25 troops, 11 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station were neutralised.

The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an assault brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and three national guard brigades close to Sergeyevka, Varvarovka, Bokovoye, Krivorozhye, Yakovlevka, Belozerskoye, and Kamenka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 345 troops, nine armoured fighting vehicles, seven motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and three electronic warfare stations.
📍
The Vostok Group's units advanced into the depth of the enemy's defence
. Manpower and hardware of an air assault brigade, an assault brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two marine brigades have been hit close to Chernenkovo (Dnepropetrovsk region), Kirovo, Zheltaya Krucha, Vasilevskoye, and Novorozovka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU lost up to 215 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and four motor vehicles have been neutralised.
↗️

▪️
Up to 25 troops, 11 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces
have inflicted damage on energy facilities, transport infrastructure employed by the AFU, ammunition depots, production workshops and storage areas of unmanned ground vehicles and unmanned aerial vehicles, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 145 areas.

item.title: ▫️ Always on the qui vive: Reconnaissance units celebrate their professional holiday on the front line
item.description: ▫️ Always on the qui vive: Reconnaissance units celebrate their professional holiday on the front line 📍 Sumy region ▫️ Servicemen of the 44th Army Corps (Sever Group of Forces) hone skills close to the line of contact. 💥 Approach, assault, withdrawal: the task of the group was to infiltrate enemy positions and seize papers. All the elements were well-drilled. 'The Day of military intelligence is very important for us. Despite this, we continue to carry out tasks and conduct combat training. For me, it's a memory day. I'm proud to serve in my unit and do what I do,' a serviceman shared. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
